data.notes: Confirmed September 2026 listings are still relatively sparse, with stronger visibility so far for ticketed concerts and classical events than for club calendars.

events.title: Kakamayka – Avihu Pinhasov
events.summary: Avihu Pinhasov presents “Kakamayka,” a large-scale standing show built around his music, with live band, movement, Georgian ballet and aerial acrobatics. The ticket listing confirms the 3 September 2026 performance at Bitan 2, Expo Tel Aviv.

events.title: Symphonic 80s!
events.summary: A Soul Events orchestral concert of 1980s pop hits, featuring SymFunny Orchestra, vocalists Sofi Chudnovski and Arkady Fainitsky, and conductor Daniil Kruglov. The event page confirms 3 September 2026 at 20:00 in Tel Aviv.

events.title: Kakamayka – Avihu Pinhasov
events.summary: A second Tel Aviv performance of Avihu Pinhasov’s “Kakamayka,” a live-band stage production expanding his music into a carnival-style show with dance and acrobatics. Megalean confirms the 4 September 2026 date at Bitan 2, Expo Tel Aviv.

events.title: Arthur Rubinstein Competition – Finals Philharmonic Session 27
events.summary: The Arthur Rubinstein International Piano Master Competition’s final stage includes a Philharmonic finals session at Heichal Hatarbut. Eventim confirms this session for 7 September 2026 at 20:00 in Tel Aviv.

events.title: Arthur Rubinstein Competition – Awards Ceremony & Winners’ Concert
events.venueName: Charles Bronfman Auditorium, Heichal Hatarbut Tel Aviv
events.summary: The competition’s September final stage culminates with an awards ceremony and winners’ concert. Eventim confirms the 9 September 2026 event at the Charles Bronfman Auditorium in Tel Aviv, with the ceremony at 19:00 and concert at 20:00.

events.title: Abu Tabla at Zappa Tel Aviv
events.summary: Abu Tabla is listed for a ticketed concert at Zappa Tel Aviv. Bimot/Eventim confirms the show for 9 September 2026 at 21:30.

events.title: Hila Ruach – New Album at Barby
events.summary: Israeli indie artist Hila Ruach is confirmed for a Barby Jaffa Port show billed as “New Album #2.” Songkick lists the event for 19 September 2026, with doors at 20:30 and tickets via Barby Bookings.
